name: Ahmad Nameh
bio: Ahmad is a Data Analysis and Reporting Expert with extensive experience producing end-to-end data solutions for clients across a wide array of industries. His background spans data collection, automation, transformation, cleansing, aggregation, analysis, and reporting.
At Alphabyte, Ahmad manages a team of 10 analysts and leads the Reporting and Analysis wing of the organization, working with clients across the US and Canada to deliver comprehensive BI solutions.

credentials.keyCoursework: Accounting · Economics · Financial Analysis · Business Analytics

achievements: Manages a team of 10 analysts leading the Reporting and Analysis wing at Alphabyte
Developed a forecast model with 98% accuracy for ROAS/ROI at the ad level at Metabolic Living
Onboarded multiple organizations to Power BI across Canadian and US divisions
Revamped entire sales and inventory reporting infrastructure at Royal Building Products, automating 25+ dashboards
Led a data clean-up effort that reconciled company financials to the penny
